## Flu model 
```{r}
##### seasonality - FLU
flu_SIRS = function(t, y, parameters) {
  S = y[1]
  I = y[2]
  R = y[3]
  mu = parameters[["mu"]]
  gamma = parameters[["gamma"]]
  omega = parameters[["omega"]]
  N = parameters[["N"]]
  controlstart = parameters[["controlstart"]]
  controlend = parameters[["controlend"]]
  controlstart2 = parameters[["controlstart2"]]
  controlend2 = parameters[["controlend2"]]
  betachange = parameters[["betachange"]]
  R0.list = parameters[["R0.list"]]

  beta=R0.list[t]*(gamma+mu)

  if(t >= controlstart & t < controlend){
    beta = betachange*beta
  }

  dS = omega*R + mu * (N - S) - beta * S * I/N
  dI = beta * S * I/N - (mu + gamma) * I
  dR = gamma*I - omega*R - mu * R
  res = c(dS, dI, dR)
  list(res)
}
```


```{r}
# set model parameters
week_start = 0
week <- seq(1,52,1)
qsim <-(0.006/2)*sin(2*pi*week/52 + 10.5) + 0.006 # based on fitting to NY q data
qsim[qsim < 0] <- 0
R0min = 1.2
R0max = 3
R0 = exp(-180*qsim + log(R0max - R0min)) + R0min
times = seq(1, 52 * 80,by = 1)
R0.list <- rep(R0,length=length(times))

# run model
out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                        func = flu_SIRS, 
                        parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                     gamma = 1, omega = 1/40, 
                                     controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                     controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                     betachange = 0.6, 
                                     controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                     controlend2 = (52*400))))


# save time series
png("figures/fig2/flutseries.png", width =5, height = 3.1,
units = 'in',res =300)
par(mar = c(2,2,0.5,0.5))
plot(out$I[out$time>(59*52) & out$time<(69*52) ]/max(out$I[out$time>(58*52) & out$time<(59*52) ]), type = 'l',col = flu_color,lwd =2,bty = 'l',xlab = '',ylab = 'norm. cases',ylim = c(0,2.5))
dev.off()
out.sub <- out[out$time>(40*52),]
flu_I <- out.sub$I
flu_S <- out.sub$S

# repeat but now for counterfactual
week_start = 100000000
out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                        func = flu_SIRS, 
                        parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                     gamma = 1, omega = 1/40, 
                                     controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                     controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                     betachange = 1, 
                                     controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                     controlend2 = (52*400))))

out.sub <- out[out$time>(40*52),]
# plot(out.sub$I, type = 'l')

flu_I_counter <- out.sub$I

```

States_IC[,'I1'] = c(rep(10000,nrow(States_IC)))  #initializes with 10000 infected person per age group (This is since the N0_ages values are based on entire US population. We rescale down to population being simulated later. This allows for base endemic to occur.)

# Scale total population size down to 1 (so that the population size is stable)
# We are assuming that all locations have similar population distribution and 
# thus are rescaled by the population in each location (done later)
States_IC <- States_IC/sum(States_IC)

# convert initial condition to a vector for ODE solver
States_IC_vec <- as.vector(States_IC)
names(States_IC_vec) <- paste(rep(rownames(States_IC),ncol(States_IC)),
                              rep(colnames(States_IC),each = nrow(States_IC)), sep = " ")


ODE_solve_SIR <- function(parms,States_IC_vec,lngth_soln_months){
  times <- seq(0,lngth_soln_months,by = 1)
  solution <- ode(y=States_IC_vec, t=times,func=SIR, method = "ode45",
                  parms=parms)
  final_soln <- solution[(nrow(solution)-lngth_soln_months+1):nrow(solution),]
  # Reset time-scale to match the timescale of the data
  final_soln[,"time"] <- final_soln[,"time"]- min(final_soln[,"time"])
  return(final_soln)
}

tau_vec <- function(tau_1,tau_2){
  tau <- rep(1,length(age_cats))
  for(i in 1:5){
    tau[i] <- tau_1 * ((i-1)+0.5)+tau_2
  }
  return(tau)
}

```{r}
# load in source code and parameters to run
load("TX_parms.RData")
source('source/SIR.R')
source('source/Track_Hospitalizations.R')
# Fix taus so there is no contact matrix amplification.
TX_parms$tau_1 <- 0
TX_parms$tau_2 <- 1

# Fix the vaccination rates to 0
TX_parms$chi_m <- 0
TX_parms$chi_b <- 0
TX_parms$step_function <- FALSE

# Add parameters for perturbation
TX_parms$control_start <- 43*52
TX_parms$control_end <- 43*52 +52
TX_parms$beta_change <- 0.6

# Make plots of the model and the Error bar plots of the prop of RSV across
# age categories.
param_set <- TX_parms
param_set <- param_set[order(param_set$Loss, decreasing = FALSE),]
parms <- as.list(param_set[1,]) # take only the best parameter set
  
  # Get solution using best params
solution <- ODE_solve_SIR(parms,States_IC_vec,60*52)
RSV_I_raw <- rowSums(solution[(20*52+1):nrow(solution),
                              grep('I',colnames(solution))])  
RSV_S_raw <- rowSums(solution[(20*52+1):nrow(solution),
                              grep('S',colnames(solution))])  
hospitalizations <- Track_Hospitalizations(solution = solution,parms = parms)

# remove first 20 burn in years

hospitalizations[,1] <-hospitalizations[,1] - min(hospitalizations[,1])

## Comparing Flu and RSV
```{r}
# get normalization factors for each
flu_Inorm <- max(flu_I[1:52])
flu_Snorm <- max(flu_I[1:52])
RSV_Inorm <- max(RSV_I_raw[1:52])
RSV_Snorm <- max(RSV_I_raw[1:52])


# recenter S-I phase plane for RSV due to damped oscillations
years <- length(RSV_S_raw) / 52
target_mean <- mean(RSV_S_raw[1:52])

mult_S <- rep(1, length(RSV_S_raw))
for (year in 1:years) {
  idx <- (1 + (year-1)*52):(year*52)
  year_mean <- mean(RSV_S_raw[idx])
  mult_S[idx] <- target_mean / year_mean
}


# plot phase planes
idxs <- (1:length(RSV_S_raw))>(20*52)
RSV_mod <- RSV_S_raw*mult_S
png("figures/fig2/fluphase.png", width =2.5, height = 2.75,
    units = 'in',res =300)
par(mar = c(2,2,0.5,0.5))
plot(flu_S[idxs]/flu_Snorm,flu_I[idxs]/flu_Inorm, bty = 'l', xlab = '',
     ylab = '',type = 'l', col = flu_color,
     ylim = c(min(c(flu_I[idxs]/flu_Inorm,RSV_I_raw[idxs]/RSV_Inorm)),
              max(c(flu_I[idxs]/flu_Inorm,RSV_I_raw[idxs]/RSV_Inorm))),
     xlim = c(min(c(flu_S[idxs]/flu_Snorm)),
              max(c(flu_S[idxs]/flu_Snorm))),lwd = 2)
dev.off()
png("figures/fig2/RSVphase.png", width =2.55, height = 2.75,
    units = 'in',res =300)
par(mar = c(2,0.75,0.5,0.5))
plot(RSV_mod[idxs]/RSV_Snorm,RSV_I_raw[idxs]/RSV_Inorm, bty = 'l',xlab= '',
      ylab = '',type = 'l', col= RSV_color,lwd = 2,
      ylim = c(min(c(flu_I[idxs]/flu_Inorm,RSV_I_raw[idxs]/RSV_Inorm)),
               max(c(flu_I[idxs]/flu_Inorm,RSV_I_raw[idxs]/RSV_Inorm))),
      xlim = c(min(c(RSV_mod[idxs]/RSV_Snorm)),
               max(c(RSV_mod[idxs]/RSV_Snorm))),yaxt = 'n')
axis(2,labels = F)
dev.off()

```

```{r}
# compute short and long term burdens
flu_metric_short <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-51))
RSV_metric_short <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(RSV_I)-51))
flu_metric_long <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-51))
RSV_metric_long <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(RSV_I)-51))

  
denom_window_len <- 51
for(i in 1:length(flu_metric_short)){
  num_len <- 4
  num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
  denom_window <- i:(i+denom_window_len)
  
  numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
  denominator <- max(flu_I_counter[denom_window])
  flu_metric_short[i] <- numerator/denominator
  
  numerator <- sum(RSV_I[num_window]-RSV_I_counter[num_window])
  denominator <- max(RSV_I_counter[denom_window])
  RSV_metric_short[i] <- numerator/denominator
  
  flu_metric_long[i]<-sum(flu_I[1:(i+denom_window_len)]-
                            flu_I_counter[1:(i+denom_window_len)])/max( 
                              flu_I_counter[1:(i+denom_window_len)])
  
  RSV_metric_long[i]<-sum(RSV_I[1:(i+denom_window_len)]-
                            RSV_I_counter[1:(i+denom_window_len)])/max( 
                              RSV_I_counter[1:(i+denom_window_len)])
}

# make plots
png("figures/fig2/short_metrictseries.png", width =5.1, height = 2.3,
    units = 'in',res =300)
par(mar = c(2,2,0.5,0.5))

segments(x1 = xargmax, 
         y0 = max(flu_metric_short), 
         x0 = par("usr")[1], 
         y1 = max(flu_metric_short),lty = 2, lwd = 2, col = flu_color)

dev.off()

png("figures/fig2/long_metrictseries.png", width =5.1, height = 2.3,
    units = 'in',res =300)
par(mar = c(2,2,0.5,0.5))
plot(RSV_metric_long[start:end-51], type = 'l', ylim = c(-10,4),col= RSV_color, lwd =2, 
     bty ='l')

}

## Overview of burden metrics

```{r,eval = T}
# set base parameters
R0min = 2.2-0.75
R0max = 2.2+0.75
omegas = seq(0.012,0.02, length.out = 25)
betachanges <- seq(0.6,1,length.out = 25)
durations <- seq(10, 52,length.out = 25)

# matrices to store
shortomegabeta.mat <- matrix(0,nrow = 25,ncol = 25)
shortomegaduration.mat <- matrix(0,nrow = 25,ncol = 25)
longomegabeta.mat <- matrix(0,nrow = 25,ncol = 25)
longomegaduration.mat <- matrix(0,nrow = 25,ncol = 25)

# compute each metric for each combination
for(row_num in 1:100){
  for(col_num in 1:25){
  omega <- omegas[row_num]
  beta_change <- betachanges[col_num]

  week <- seq(1,52,1)
  qsim <-(0.006/2)*sin(2*pi*week/52 + 10.5) + 0.006 # based on fitting to NY q data
  qsim[qsim < 0] <- 0
  R0 = exp(-180*qsim + log(R0max - R0min)) + R0min
  
        
  times = seq(1, 52 * 73,by = 1)
  R0.list <- rep(R0,length=length(times))
    
  week_start = 100000000
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 1, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
    
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I_counter <- out.sub$I
      
  first_year <- flu_I_counter[1:52]
  t_max <- which.max(first_year)
      
  week_start <- t_max
  
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = beta_change, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
  
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I <- out.sub$I
  
  denom_window_len <- 51
  month_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  threemonth_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  annual_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  
  for(i in 1:length(month_metric)){
      num_len <- 4
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      denom_window <- i:(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      denominator <- max(flu_I_counter[denom_window])
      month_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_len <- 12
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      threemonth_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_window <- (1):(i+denom_window_len)
      annual_metric[i] <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      
  }
  
  annual_metric <- annual_metric/max(flu_I_counter)

    shortomegabeta.mat[row_num,col_num] <- max(month_metric)
    longomegabeta.mat[row_num,col_num] <-annual_metric[length(annual_metric)]
  }
}

for(row_num in 1:100){
  for(col_num in 1:25){
  omega <- omegas[row_num]

  week <- seq(1,52,1)

                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 1,

                          func = flu_SIRS,

                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + duration+week_start),
                                       betachange = 0.6, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
  
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I <- out.sub$I
  
  denom_window_len <- 51
  month_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  threemonth_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  annual_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  
  for(i in 1:length(month_metric)){
      num_len <- 4
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      denom_window <- i:(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      denominator <- max(flu_I_counter[denom_window])
      month_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_len <- 12
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      threemonth_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_window <- (1):(i+denom_window_len)
      annual_metric[i] <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      
  }
  
  annual_metric <- annual_metric/max(flu_I_counter)

    shortomegaduration.mat[row_num,col_num] <- max(month_metric)
    longomegaduration.mat[row_num,col_num] <-annual_metric[length(annual_metric)]
  }
}

## Bifurcation diagram
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# set parameter range
R0_avgs <- seq(1,10, length.out = 100)
omegas <- seq(1/520,0.025,length.out = 100)

# make matrices to store
mat <- matrix(NA,nrow = length(omegas),ncol = length(R0_avgs))
mat_90 <- matrix(NA,nrow = length(omegas),ncol = length(R0_avgs))
mat_95 <- matrix(NA,nrow = length(omegas),ncol = length(R0_avgs))
mat_99 <- matrix(NA,nrow = length(omegas),ncol = length(R0_avgs))

# store bifurcation data based on multiple thresholds
for(i in 1:length(omegas)){
  for(j in 1:length(R0_avgs)){
    omega <- omegas[i]
    R0_avg <- R0_avgs[j]
        
    week_start = 0
      week <- seq(1,52,1)
      qsim <-(0.006/2)*sin(2*pi*week/52 + 10.5) + 0.006 # based on fitting to NY q data
      qsim[qsim < 0] <- 0
      R0 = exp(-180*qsim + log(1.5)) + R0_avg-0.75
      
      times = seq(1, 52 * 73,by = 1)
      R0.list <- rep(R0,length=length(times))
    
        week_start = 100000000
        out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                                func = flu_SIRS, 
                                parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                             gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                             controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                             controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                             betachange = 1, 
                                             controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                             controlend2 = (52*400))))
      
    out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
    flu_I_counter <- out.sub$I
    
    if(any(is.na(flu_I_counter))){
      label <- "none"
      label_90 <- "none"
      label_95 <- "none"
      label_99 <- "none"
      }else{
        if(max(flu_I_counter)<1e-6){
          label <- "none"
          label_90 <- "none"
          label_95 <- "none"
          label_99 <- "none"
          } else{
            first_year <- max(flu_I_counter[1:52])
            first_year_min <- min(flu_I_counter[1:52])
            second_year <- max(flu_I_counter[53:104])
            third_year <- max(flu_I_counter[105:156])
            if(abs(first_year-third_year)>(first_year*0.025)){
              label <- "other"
              label_90 <- "other"
              label_95 <- "other"
              label_99 <- "other"
              }else{
                if(abs(first_year-second_year)>(max(c(first_year,
                                              second_year))*0.05)){
                  label <- "biennial"
                  label_90 <- "biennial"
                  label_95 <- "biennial"
                  label_99 <- "biennial"
                  }else{
                    label <- "annual"
                    if(first_year_min/first_year<=0.1){
                      label_90 <- "annual"
                    }else{
                      label_90 <- "high_annual"
                    }
                    if(first_year_min/first_year<=0.05){
                      label_95 <- "annual"
                    }else{
                      label_95 <- "high_annual"
                    }
                    if(first_year_min/first_year<=0.01){
                      label_99 <- "annual"
                    }else{
                      label_99 <- "high_annual"
                    }
                  }
              }
          }
        }
    mat[i,j] <- label
    mat_90[i,j] <- label_90
    mat_95[i,j] <- label_95
    mat_99[i,j] <- label_99
  }
}

save(mat,file = "Biff_old.RData")
save(mat_90,file = "Biff_90.RData")
save(mat_95,file = "Biff_95.RData")
save(mat_99,file = "Biff_99.RData")

load("Biff_99.RData")

# reshape into nice data frame

                      bif_90 = mat_90[1,1],bif_95 = mat_95[1,1],bif_99 = mat_99[1,1])

for(i in 1:length(omegas)){
  for(j in 1:length(R0_avgs)){
    new_row <- data.frame(omegas = omegas[i], R0_avgs = R0_avgs[j], bif = mat[i,j],
                      bif_90 = mat_90[i,j],bif_95 = mat_95[i,j],bif_99 = mat_99[i,j])
    full_df <- rbind(full_df, new_row)
  }
}

```{r,eval = F}
# select parameters on the 10% threshold
viable_df <- full_df[full_df$bif_90 == "annual",]

# set empty variables for storage
viable_df$midpeak_monthlyburden <- NA
viable_df$offpeak_monthlyburden <- NA
viable_df$prevpeak_monthlyburden <- NA

viable_df$midpeak_3monthburden <- NA
viable_df$offpeak_3monthburden <- NA
viable_df$prevpeak_3monthburden <- NA

viable_df$midpeak_maxannualburden <- NA
viable_df$offpeak_maxannualburden <- NA
viable_df$prevpeak_maxannualburden <- NA

viable_df$midpeak_maxannualcases <- NA
viable_df$offpeak_maxannualcases <- NA
viable_df$prevpeak_maxannualcases <- NA

viable_df$midpeak_longtermdiff <- NA
viable_df$offpeak_longtermdiff <- NA
viable_df$prevpeak_longtermdiff <- NA

# compute metrics along all perturabtion timings
for(nrow in 1:nrow(viable_df)){
  omega <- viable_df$omegas[nrow]
  R0_avg <- viable_df$R0_avgs[nrow]
          
  week <- seq(1,52,1)
  qsim <-(0.006/2)*sin(2*pi*week/52 + 10.5) + 0.006 # based on fitting to NY q data
  qsim[qsim < 0] <- 0
  R0 = exp(-180*qsim + log(1.5)) + R0_avg-0.75
        
  times = seq(1, 52 * 73,by = 1)
  R0.list <- rep(R0,length=length(times))
    
  week_start = 100000000
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 1, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
    
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I_counter <- out.sub$I
      
  first_year <- flu_I_counter[1:52]
  t_max <- which.max(first_year)
      
  week_start <- t_max
  
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 0.6, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
  
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I <- out.sub$I
  
  denom_window_len <- 51
  month_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  threemonth_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  
  for(i in 1:length(month_metric)){
      num_len <- 4
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      denom_window <- i:(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      denominator <- max(flu_I_counter[denom_window])
      month_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_len <- 12
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      threemonth_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
  }
  
  annual_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  max_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  for(i in 1:18){
    tot_cases <- sum(flu_I[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    annual_metric[i] <- tot_cases-sum(flu_I_counter[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    max_metric[i] <- tot_cases
  }
  
  viable_df$midpeak_monthlyburden[nrow] <- max(month_metric)
  viable_df$midpeak_3monthburden[nrow] <- max(threemonth_metric)
  viable_df$midpeak_maxannualburden[nrow] <- max(annual_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$midpeak_maxannualcases[nrow] <- max(max_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$midpeak_longtermdiff[nrow] <- (sum(flu_I)-sum(flu_I_counter))/max(flu_I_counter)
  
  ########## off peak
  week_start <- t_max-26
  
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 0.6, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
  
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I <- out.sub$I
  
  month_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  threemonth_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  
  denom_window_len <- 51
  for(i in 1:length(month_metric)){
      num_len <- 4
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      denom_window <- i:(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      denominator <- max(flu_I_counter[denom_window])
      month_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_len <- 12
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      threemonth_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
  }
  
  annual_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  max_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  for(i in 1:18){
    tot_cases <- sum(flu_I[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    annual_metric[i] <- tot_cases-sum(flu_I_counter[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    max_metric[i] <- tot_cases
  }
  
  viable_df$offpeak_monthlyburden[nrow] <- max(month_metric)
  viable_df$offpeak_3monthburden[nrow] <- max(threemonth_metric)
  viable_df$offpeak_maxannualburden[nrow] <- max(annual_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$offpeak_maxannualcases[nrow] <- max(max_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$offpeak_longtermdiff[nrow] <- (sum(flu_I)-sum(flu_I_counter))/max(flu_I_counter)
  
  
  
  ########## prev peak
  week_start <- t_max-13
  
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 0.6, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
  
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I <- out.sub$I
  
  month_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  threemonth_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  
  denom_window_len <- 51
  for(i in 1:length(month_metric)){
      num_len <- 4
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      denom_window <- i:(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      denominator <- max(flu_I_counter[denom_window])
      month_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_len <- 12
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      threemonth_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
  }
  
  annual_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  max_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  for(i in 1:18){
    tot_cases <- sum(flu_I[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    annual_metric[i] <- tot_cases-sum(flu_I_counter[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    max_metric[i] <- tot_cases
  }
  
  viable_df$prevpeak_monthlyburden[nrow] <- max(month_metric)
  viable_df$prevpeak_3monthburden[nrow] <- max(threemonth_metric)
  viable_df$prevpeak_maxannualburden[nrow] <- max(annual_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$prevpeak_maxannualcases[nrow] <- max(max_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$prevpeak_longtermdiff[nrow] <- (sum(flu_I)-sum(flu_I_counter))/max(flu_I_counter)
  if ((nrow%%100)==0){
    print(nrow)
  }
}
save(viable_df,file = "mapdata_nohigh.RData")

## Flu model 
```{r}
##### seasonality - FLU
flu_SIRS = function(t, y, parameters) {
  S = y[1]
  I = y[2]
  R = y[3]
  mu = parameters[["mu"]]
  gamma = parameters[["gamma"]]
  omega = parameters[["omega"]]
  N = parameters[["N"]]
  controlstart = parameters[["controlstart"]]
  controlend = parameters[["controlend"]]
  controlstart2 = parameters[["controlstart2"]]
  controlend2 = parameters[["controlend2"]]
  betachange = parameters[["betachange"]]
  R0.list = parameters[["R0.list"]]

  beta=R0.list[t]*(gamma+mu)

  if(t >= controlstart & t < controlend){
    beta = betachange*beta
  }

  dS = omega*R + mu * (N - S) - beta * S * I/N
  dI = beta * S * I/N - (mu + gamma) * I
  dR = gamma*I - omega*R - mu * R
  res = c(dS, dI, dR)
  list(res)
}
```


```{r}
# set model parameters
week_start = 0
week <- seq(1,52,1)
qsim <-(0.006/2)*sin(2*pi*week/52 + 10.5) + 0.006 # based on fitting to NY q data
qsim[qsim < 0] <- 0
R0min = 1.2
R0max = 3
R0 = exp(-180*qsim + log(R0max - R0min)) + R0min
times = seq(1, 52 * 80,by = 1)
R0.list <- rep(R0,length=length(times))

# run model
out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                        func = flu_SIRS,

States_IC[,'I1'] = c(rep(10000,nrow(States_IC)))  #initializes with 10000 infected person per age group (This is since the N0_ages values are based on entire US population. We rescale down to population being simulated later. This allows for base endemic to occur.)

# Scale total population size down to 1 (so that the population size is stable)
# We are assuming that all locations have similar population distribution and 
# thus are rescaled by the population in each location (done later)
States_IC <- States_IC/sum(States_IC)

# convert initial condition to a vector for ODE solver
States_IC_vec <- as.vector(States_IC)
names(States_IC_vec) <- paste(rep(rownames(States_IC),ncol(States_IC)),
                              rep(colnames(States_IC),each = nrow(States_IC)), sep = " ")


ODE_solve_SIR <- function(parms,States_IC_vec,lngth_soln_months){
  times <- seq(0,lngth_soln_months,by = 1)
  solution <- ode(y=States_IC_vec, t=times,func=SIR, method = "ode45",
                  parms=parms)
  final_soln <- solution[(nrow(solution)-lngth_soln_months+1):nrow(solution),]
  # Reset time-scale to match the timescale of the data
  final_soln[,"time"] <- final_soln[,"time"]- min(final_soln[,"time"])
  return(final_soln)
}

tau_vec <- function(tau_1,tau_2){
  tau <- rep(1,length(age_cats))
  for(i in 1:5){
    tau[i] <- tau_1 * ((i-1)+0.5)+tau_2
  }
  return(tau)
}

```{r}
# get normalization factors for each

RSV_Snorm <- max(RSV_I_raw[1:52])


# recenter S-I phase plane for RSV due to damped oscillations
years <- length(RSV_S_raw) / 52
target_mean <- mean(RSV_S_raw[1:52])

mult_S <- rep(1, length(RSV_S_raw))
for (year in 1:years) {
  idx <- (1 + (year-1)*52):(year*52)
  year_mean <- mean(RSV_S_raw[idx])
  mult_S[idx] <- target_mean / year_mean
}


# plot phase planes

## Overview of burden metrics

```{r,eval = T}
# set base parameters
R0min = 2.2-0.75
R0max = 2.2+0.75
omegas = seq(0.012,0.02, length.out = 25)
betachanges <- seq(0.6,1,length.out = 25)
durations <- seq(10, 52,length.out = 25)

# matrices to store
shortomegabeta.mat <- matrix(0,nrow = 25,ncol = 25)
shortomegaduration.mat <- matrix(0,nrow = 25,ncol = 25)
longomegabeta.mat <- matrix(0,nrow = 25,ncol = 25)
longomegaduration.mat <- matrix(0,nrow = 25,ncol = 25)

# compute each metric for each combination
for(row_num in 1:100){
  for(col_num in 1:25){
  omega <- omegas[row_num]
  beta_change <- betachanges[col_num]

  week <- seq(1,52,1)
  qsim <-(0.006/2)*sin(2*pi*week/52 + 10.5) + 0.006 # based on fitting to NY q data
  qsim[qsim < 0] <- 0
  R0 = exp(-180*qsim + log(R0max - R0min)) + R0min
  
        
  times = seq(1, 52 * 73,by = 1)
  R0.list <- rep(R0,length=length(times))
    
  week_start = 100000000
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 1, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
    
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I_counter <- out.sub$I
      
  first_year <- flu_I_counter[1:52]
  t_max <- which.max(first_year)
      
  week_start <- t_max
  
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = beta_change, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
  
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I <- out.sub$I
  
  denom_window_len <- 51
  month_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  threemonth_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  annual_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  
  for(i in 1:length(month_metric)){
      num_len <- 4
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      denom_window <- i:(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      denominator <- max(flu_I_counter[denom_window])
      month_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_len <- 12
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      threemonth_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_window <- (1):(i+denom_window_len)
      annual_metric[i] <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      
  }
  
  annual_metric <- annual_metric/max(flu_I_counter)

    shortomegabeta.mat[row_num,col_num] <- max(month_metric)
    longomegabeta.mat[row_num,col_num] <-annual_metric[length(annual_metric)]
  }
}

## Bifurcation diagram
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# set parameter range
R0_avgs <- seq(1,10, length.out = 100)
omegas <- seq(1/520,0.025,length.out = 100)

# make matrices to store
mat <- matrix(NA,nrow = length(omegas),ncol = length(R0_avgs))
mat_90 <- matrix(NA,nrow = length(omegas),ncol = length(R0_avgs))
mat_95 <- matrix(NA,nrow = length(omegas),ncol = length(R0_avgs))
mat_99 <- matrix(NA,nrow = length(omegas),ncol = length(R0_avgs))

# store bifurcation data based on multiple thresholds
for(i in 1:length(omegas)){
  for(j in 1:length(R0_avgs)){
    omega <- omegas[i]
    R0_avg <- R0_avgs[j]
        
    week_start = 0
      week <- seq(1,52,1)
      qsim <-(0.006/2)*sin(2*pi*week/52 + 10.5) + 0.006 # based on fitting to NY q data
      qsim[qsim < 0] <- 0
      R0 = exp(-180*qsim + log(1.5)) + R0_avg-0.75
      
      times = seq(1, 52 * 73,by = 1)
      R0.list <- rep(R0,length=length(times))
    
        week_start = 100000000
        out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                                func = flu_SIRS, 
                                parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                             gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                             controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                             controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                             betachange = 1, 
                                             controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                             controlend2 = (52*400))))
      
    out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
    flu_I_counter <- out.sub$I
    
    if(any(is.na(flu_I_counter))){
      label <- "none"
      label_90 <- "none"
      label_95 <- "none"
      label_99 <- "none"
      }else{
        if(max(flu_I_counter)<1e-6){
          label <- "none"
          label_90 <- "none"
          label_95 <- "none"
          label_99 <- "none"
          } else{
            first_year <- max(flu_I_counter[1:52])
            first_year_min <- min(flu_I_counter[1:52])
            second_year <- max(flu_I_counter[53:104])
            third_year <- max(flu_I_counter[105:156])
            if(abs(first_year-third_year)>(first_year*0.025)){
              label <- "other"
              label_90 <- "other"
              label_95 <- "other"
              label_99 <- "other"
              }else{
                if(abs(first_year-second_year)>(max(c(first_year,
                                              second_year))*0.05)){
                  label <- "biennial"
                  label_90 <- "biennial"
                  label_95 <- "biennial"
                  label_99 <- "biennial"
                  }else{
                    label <- "annual"
                    if(first_year_min/first_year<=0.1){
                      label_90 <- "annual"
                    }else{
                      label_90 <- "high_annual"
                    }
                    if(first_year_min/first_year<=0.05){
                      label_95 <- "annual"
                    }else{
                      label_95 <- "high_annual"
                    }
                    if(first_year_min/first_year<=0.01){
                      label_99 <- "annual"
                    }else{
                      label_99 <- "high_annual"
                    }
                  }
              }
          }
        }
    mat[i,j] <- label
    mat_90[i,j] <- label_90
    mat_95[i,j] <- label_95
    mat_99[i,j] <- label_99
  }
}

save(mat,file = "Biff_old.RData")
save(mat_90,file = "Biff_90.RData")
save(mat_95,file = "Biff_95.RData")
save(mat_99,file = "Biff_99.RData")

```{r,eval = F}
# select parameters on the 10% threshold
viable_df <- full_df[full_df$bif_90 == "annual",]

# set empty variables for storage
viable_df$midpeak_monthlyburden <- NA
viable_df$offpeak_monthlyburden <- NA
viable_df$prevpeak_monthlyburden <- NA

viable_df$midpeak_3monthburden <- NA
viable_df$offpeak_3monthburden <- NA
viable_df$prevpeak_3monthburden <- NA

viable_df$midpeak_maxannualburden <- NA
viable_df$offpeak_maxannualburden <- NA
viable_df$prevpeak_maxannualburden <- NA

viable_df$midpeak_maxannualcases <- NA
viable_df$offpeak_maxannualcases <- NA
viable_df$prevpeak_maxannualcases <- NA

viable_df$midpeak_longtermdiff <- NA
viable_df$offpeak_longtermdiff <- NA
viable_df$prevpeak_longtermdiff <- NA

# compute metrics along all perturabtion timings
for(nrow in 1:nrow(viable_df)){
  omega <- viable_df$omegas[nrow]
  R0_avg <- viable_df$R0_avgs[nrow]
          
  week <- seq(1,52,1)
  qsim <-(0.006/2)*sin(2*pi*week/52 + 10.5) + 0.006 # based on fitting to NY q data
  qsim[qsim < 0] <- 0
  R0 = exp(-180*qsim + log(1.5)) + R0_avg-0.75
        
  times = seq(1, 52 * 73,by = 1)
  R0.list <- rep(R0,length=length(times))
    
  week_start = 100000000
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 1, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
    
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I_counter <- out.sub$I
      
  first_year <- flu_I_counter[1:52]
  t_max <- which.max(first_year)
      
  week_start <- t_max
  
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 0.6, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
  
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I <- out.sub$I
  
  denom_window_len <- 51
  month_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  threemonth_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  
  for(i in 1:length(month_metric)){
      num_len <- 4
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      denom_window <- i:(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      denominator <- max(flu_I_counter[denom_window])
      month_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_len <- 12
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      threemonth_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
  }
  
  annual_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  max_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  for(i in 1:18){
    tot_cases <- sum(flu_I[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    annual_metric[i] <- tot_cases-sum(flu_I_counter[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    max_metric[i] <- tot_cases
  }
  
  viable_df$midpeak_monthlyburden[nrow] <- max(month_metric)
  viable_df$midpeak_3monthburden[nrow] <- max(threemonth_metric)
  viable_df$midpeak_maxannualburden[nrow] <- max(annual_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$midpeak_maxannualcases[nrow] <- max(max_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$midpeak_longtermdiff[nrow] <- (sum(flu_I)-sum(flu_I_counter))/max(flu_I_counter)
  
  ########## off peak
  week_start <- t_max-26
  
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 0.6, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
  
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I <- out.sub$I
  
  month_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  threemonth_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  
  denom_window_len <- 51
  for(i in 1:length(month_metric)){
      num_len <- 4
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      denom_window <- i:(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      denominator <- max(flu_I_counter[denom_window])
      month_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_len <- 12
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      threemonth_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
  }
  
  annual_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  max_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  for(i in 1:18){
    tot_cases <- sum(flu_I[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    annual_metric[i] <- tot_cases-sum(flu_I_counter[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    max_metric[i] <- tot_cases
  }
  
  viable_df$offpeak_monthlyburden[nrow] <- max(month_metric)
  viable_df$offpeak_3monthburden[nrow] <- max(threemonth_metric)
  viable_df$offpeak_maxannualburden[nrow] <- max(annual_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$offpeak_maxannualcases[nrow] <- max(max_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$offpeak_longtermdiff[nrow] <- (sum(flu_I)-sum(flu_I_counter))/max(flu_I_counter)
  
  
  
  ########## prev peak
  week_start <- t_max-13
  
  out = as.data.frame(ode(y = c(S = 0.19, I = 0.01, R = 0.8), times = times, 
                          func = flu_SIRS, 
                          parms = list(mu = 1/(50 * 52), N = 1, R0.list = R0.list,
                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega, 
                                       controlstart = (52*63+week_start), 
                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 0.6, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
  
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I <- out.sub$I
  
  month_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  threemonth_metric <-rep(NA,length.out = (length(flu_I)-denom_window_len))
  
  denom_window_len <- 51
  for(i in 1:length(month_metric)){
      num_len <- 4
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      denom_window <- i:(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      denominator <- max(flu_I_counter[denom_window])
      month_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      num_len <- 12
      num_window <- (i+denom_window_len-num_len):(i+denom_window_len)
      numerator <- sum(flu_I[num_window]-flu_I_counter[num_window])
      threemonth_metric[i] <- numerator/denominator
  }
  
  annual_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  max_metric <- rep(NA,length.out = 18)
  for(i in 1:18){
    tot_cases <- sum(flu_I[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    annual_metric[i] <- tot_cases-sum(flu_I_counter[((i-1)*52+1):(i*52)])
    max_metric[i] <- tot_cases
  }
  
  viable_df$prevpeak_monthlyburden[nrow] <- max(month_metric)
  viable_df$prevpeak_3monthburden[nrow] <- max(threemonth_metric)
  viable_df$prevpeak_maxannualburden[nrow] <- max(annual_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$prevpeak_maxannualcases[nrow] <- max(max_metric)/max(flu_I_counter)
  viable_df$prevpeak_longtermdiff[nrow] <- (sum(flu_I)-sum(flu_I_counter))/max(flu_I_counter)
  if ((nrow%%100)==0){
    print(nrow)
  }
}

                                       gamma = 1, omega = omega,

                                       controlend =(52*63 + 52+week_start),
                                       betachange = 0.6, 
                                       controlstart2 = (52*400)-1 ,
                                       controlend2 = (52*400))))
  
  out.sub <- out[out$time>(55*52),]
  flu_I <- out.sub$I
      png(paste0("figures/supplement/fig4dynamics/",omega,"R0",R0_avg,".png"),
          width =3, height = 2.5,units = 'in',res =300)
      idxs_to_plot <- (3*52):(14*52)
      par(mar = c(2,2,0.5,0.75))
      plot(flu_I[idxs_to_plot]/max(first_year),type = 'l',main = "", col = 'black', lwd = 2,
           ylim = c(0,6),
           bty = 'l',bty = 'l',ylab ="",xlab ="")
      lines(flu_I_counter[idxs_to_plot]/max(first_year), lty =2, col = 'red', lwd =2)
      abline(v = 5*52+52+week_start, lty = 2, col = 'grey', lwd = 2)
      abline(v = 5*52+week_start,lty = 2, col = 'grey', lwd = 2)
      dev.off()
  }
}
```



## Extended heatmaps of four metrics and three perturbation timings
```{r}
# load in heatmap data
load("mapdata_nohigh.RData")
# remove incorrect points
viable_df <- viable_df[viable_df$R0_avgs>1.5,]
viable_df <- viable_df[-c(994),]

# set colors
mako <- viridisLite::mako(256)

# plot and save heat maps
metrics <- c("monthlyburden","3monthburden","maxannualburden","longtermdiff")
shifts <- c("prevpeak","midpeak","offpeak")
for(i in 1:length(shifts)){
  for(j in 1:length(metrics)){
    metric_name <- paste0(shifts[i],"_",metrics[j])
    plt <- ggplot(viable_df, aes(x = omegas, y = R0_avgs, 
                                 fill = round(.data[[metric_name]],8))) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = mako) +   
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),          # removes grey background grid
    legend.position = "bottom"             # moves legend to bottom
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    direction = "horizontal",
    barwidth = 10,
    barheight = 0.8
  ))
    print(plt)
    ggsave(paste0("figures/heat_all/",metric_name,".png"), plot = plt,
    height = 4, width = 3.75, dpi = 300)
  }
}
